summary: Find every green color-3 connected component whose full bounding box contains only green 3 and red 2. Red cells inside those valid bboxes are markers. Paint a clipped 3x3 blue color-1 halo around every marker while preserving all interior markers, including overlapping ones. Red cells outside valid bboxes are distractors and do not trigger halos.
